mission.goal: Preserve the JARVIS v1.4 authority and assurance foundation while adding proof-bearing 20-minute Alpha-Omega execution, route-specific outcomes, failure-genome replay and quality-gated method improvement.
mission.user: Kagiso Kim Mosiane as sovereign owner and operator
mission.workflow: intake -> current verified state -> objective/form/state-delta lock -> advisory twin -> bounded multi-path/multi-stream execution -> exact authority gate -> assurance fan-in -> semantic readback -> unpromoted learning capture -> terminal receipt plus next automated route
mission.data: Untrusted objectives and provider outputs are processed in memory; only secret-free hashes, route state, elapsed time, evidence references, completion state and learning status are persisted in the local hash chain.
mission.interface: Responsive browser UI, JSON HTTP API, CLI and Google ADK 2 Workflow entrypoint
mission.stack: Python 3.11-3.14, google-adk 2.1.0, google-genai 1.75.0, cryptography 46.0.0, uv 0.11.33 universal lock, stdlib HTTP and Docker
mission.environment: The v1.4 core is locally verified. The T20 overlay requires same-commit Airlock readback. Gemini, Workspace, Cloud Run and Federation adapters require environment-specific authority proof.
mission.governance: One sovereign executor, typed response/action/resource/argument schemas, full effective-authority intersection, public-key-verified subject/mission-version/resource/argument-bound single-use permits, untrusted external content, structured quality evidence, independent adversarial proof, route-specific readback and no runtime self-promotion.
mission.failure: Invalid input, untyped or stale quality evidence, authorization denial, no-op recurrence, missing provider configuration, dependency failure, timeout, partial writes, unauthenticated or replayed recovery receipts, ledger deletion/rollback/replay/tamper and route recurrence fail closed or quarantine only the affected route.
mission.testing: The inherited v1.4 security and assurance suite remains intact. The T20 overlay adds policy, evidence, route-accounting, no-op, deadline, next-pathway, email-authority, HTTP and 72-hour lesson-gate regressions. Same-commit provider CI is pending for the current source head.
mission.deployment: Container source exists; dependency resolution and installed-package proof passed for v1.4. Promotion remains blocked until same-commit T20 Airlock readback, isolated production signer and global state, machine identity, private canary, exact lineage, semantic readback, rollback and cost gates pass.
mission.continuity: Atomic hash-chain state with a retained separate file anchor, circuit quarantine, in-process atomic generation-bound two-receipt restoration, project memory, Formation specification, AI handoff, the 72-hour lesson gate and an archived pre-gate T20 head preserve bounded continuity.

assumptions.stack: Python is the primary runtime; exact direct pins and the checked-in universal uv.lock bind the Google ADK/GenAI dependency graph.
assumptions.runtime: Linux/Cloud Run compatible runtime with a non-root identity and writable JARVIS_STATE_DIR.
assumptions.storage: Local JSONL is sufficient for source verification; managed transactional state is required before horizontal production scaling.
assumptions.authentication: Local HTTP uses a bearer secret; Google capabilities use separate least-scope OAuth or dedicated service identity.
assumptions.execution_time: The 1,200-second envelope governs one JARVIS attempt and cannot force external-provider latency or human approval.
assumptions.deployment: No live deployment claim is allowed until the provider-native zero-traffic gate succeeds.

components.frontend: Packaged responsive HTML interface with loading, error, token and capability-truth controls
components.backend: Typed Python domain objects, canonical five-node deterministic graph, HTTP/CLI and ADK Workflow entrypoints
components.execution_governor: T20-AO-OMEGA-SCIENTIST-1.1 with three bounded paths, six streams, structured evidence, no-op circuit, convergence controls and next-pathway release
components.database: Concurrency-safe hash-chained JSONL; managed production database ADAPTER_REQUIRED before multi-instance writes
components.queue: NOT_APPLICABLE: no asynchronous effectful jobs are enabled in this release
components.worker: Single synchronous governed graph; provider tool worker is feature-disabled
components.scheduler: NOT_APPLICABLE: on-demand release has no background autonomy
components.cache: NOT_APPLICABLE: semantic/model responses are not cached
components.storage: Local atomic state, packaged versioned doctrine resource and machine-readable 72-hour lesson gate
components.authentication: Constant-time bearer comparison; typed request schemas and exact user grant/OAuth/IAM/mission/tool/resource intersection for future provider adapters

observability.correlation_ids: Mission IDs, route IDs, content hashes, T20 receipt digests and learning hashes
observability.health_checks: GET /health separates ledger integrity, provider mode, execution policy, lesson gate, session proof and maturity
observability.structured_logs: Secret-free JSON response and ledger schemas; raw prompts and provider payloads are not logged
observability.audit_logs: Fsync-backed hash-chain plus authenticated checkpoint and separately located high-water anchor; production managed immutability remains required
observability.metrics_alerts: Local elapsed time, evidence status, route state, no-op circuit, completion state, semantic fruit and quarantine state; provider alerting ADAPTER_REQUIRED before deployment

execution.quality_evidence: Structured fresh evidence objects only; caller booleans and generic transport success are rejected.
execution.email_send_rule: gmail.send and gmail.forward require explicit current owner grant plus exact executor authority and a single-use permit.
execution.improvement_rule: Speed gains remain shadow candidates until proof-bearing regression demonstrates no quality loss.

testing.unit: Provider settings, typed response/action/resource/argument schemas, Ed25519 permit cryptography/bindings, signed generation-bound recovery receipts, T20 timing and evidence contracts, route accounting, no-op circuit, math AST, doctrine and authority intersection
testing.integration: Canonical graph to response-contract verifier to anchored learning ledger plus proof-bearing T20 cycle review and protected HTTP routes
testing.e2e_or_smoke: CLI offline response, interactive math calculation, cloud-deploy denial, browser bootstrap ordering, packaged resource load and T20 policy/readback
testing.fixtures_mocks: Deterministic successful, failing and short-response provider doubles, typed quality evidence, route outcomes and temporary state directories
testing.failure_first: False-live env, untyped provider output, unsupported effect assertions, action/resource/argument bypass, malformed permit input, permit mismatch/expiry/replay, fabricated recovery receipts, code injection, ledger deletion/rollback/replay/tamper, caller boolean completion, stale evidence, dependent adversarial proof, no-op retry and deadline overclaim

formation.effectful_permit: The runtime holds only the Formation public verifier. GitHub publication and every provider mutation require separate current authority; external tool execution is not enabled by T20.

watchman.preserved_core: The complete v1.4 offline graph, math, doctrine, signed permits, anchored state, security gates and local interfaces remain functional when every external provider is absent.
watchman.closure_test: Each adapter must independently prove current identity, exact scopes/allowlist, semantic fruit, rollback and T20 evidence without weakening another route.

continuity.idempotency: Read routes are deterministic where possible; no effectful adapter is enabled; future writes require idempotency keys and preimages.
continuity.checkpoints: Graph node events, learning hashes, route states, T20 receipt digests, capability truth, lesson-gate mapping, contract proof and release commit/readback.
continuity.resume_conditions: Resume an isolated provider lane only after current authority, two bounded authenticated recovery receipts from distinct trust roots, cost fit and unchanged protected controls.
continuity.supersession: The pre-gate PR 548 head is preserved on archive/jarvis-t20-pre-72h-gate-20260817; the T20 overlay is stacked on the higher v1.4 foundation rather than replacing it with the simplified v1.0 branch.
continuity.stop_switch: Unset provider mode, revoke runtime secret/identity, quarantine the exact route, or enter T20 release-only/deadline state; no background executor exists.
